fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A Copy of Senior High School Graduation Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 2. Transcript of Senior High School Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Non-criminal Certificate * 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 5. A copy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 6. Scanned file of 2-inch photo * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. The physical examination form must include test results for HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. If possible, please also provide separate test reports for the following items: 1. Blood test report (must include HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C) 2. X-ray report -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Statement of Financial Support -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Your financial guarantor must fill it on computer, print it, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The financial guarantor is usually one of your parents; you cannot be your own guarantor. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Drug Test Requirement &Anti-Drug Commitment Letter * 10. Self-introduction Video in Chinese or English in MP4 format Shorter than 2 min, less than 50 MB * 11. Study plan Should be written in Chinese or English. No less than 500 words Includes but not limited to a brief self-introduction, should mainly focusing on what you want to STUDY or RESEARCH after enrolled. You can also briefly introduce your reason to apply for this program in this university in China, and your plan after graduation. It is different from personal statement or motivation letter * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Should be in good physical and mental health,be friendly towards China, have no history of drug abuse or criminal records, be willing to abide by China'slaws and the university's rules and regulations, and respect China's social and cultural customs.
